## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the change.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe affected protocols, persisted data, dependencies, security boundaries, hardware paths,
and rollback behavior. Write "None" when they do not apply.

## Verification

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Relevant Wine/DXMT smoke test, or an explanation of why it does not apply
- [ ] Documentation updated for setup, behavior, or compatibility changes
- [ ] Regression test added for a bug fix, or an explanation of why one is not practical
- [ ] No generated artifacts, credentials, device IDs, or private logs included

## Hardware validation

If applicable, list the Mac, macOS version, headset, ALVR version, connection type, settings, and
test duration. Write "Not run; deterministic change" when physical hardware is not required.
